mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A consistent increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates a strengthening economy, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of the instances where the GDP growth condition is met, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3 percentage points within a month signals a tightening labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer spending power increases.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over three consecutive months signals increased economic output, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of the instances where the INDPRO growth condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% and retail sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% over the same month, it signals a strengthening consumer demand, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer-driven sectors benefit.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increase > 5% and RSAFS increase > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of HOUST and RSAFS increases on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2 percentage points over the same month, it signals a robust labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence and spending increase.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increase > 200,000 and UNRATE decrease > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 45% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% over two consecutive months signals disinflation, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as real income increases and the Fed may consider easing monetary policy.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 35% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between CPIAUCSL decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) decreases by more than 1% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4%, it signals a potential economic slowdown due to high interest rates, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings are pressured.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of INDPRO decreases and high FEDFUNDS on negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
